title: Flora-Bama Marina & Watersports
specs: Coastal Cruiser has onboard restroom and stereo system
Jet ski rentals offer views of Orange Beach, Perdido Key, Ono Island, and local wildlife including dolphins
Must be at least 19 years old to rent a jet ski or pontoon
To drive a jet ski, must be 16 with valid driver's license and parent/guardian signature
Permits and photos of IDs are not accepted
Children under 8 and anyone under 90 lbs must wear life jacket when boat is moving
Coastal Cruiser holds up to 20 guests
Captains are independent contractors, not employees of Flora-Bama Marina

blurb: Guests can rent jet skis, pontoons, and premium tritoons or book private charters with licensed captains. Activities include dolphin watching, island hopping, sandbar fun, and sunset cruises. Rentals and charters provide access to local bays and waterways but not the Gulf itself.
